note: overlay = directory under reviewer/variants/docstore/ whose files replace pristine files; edits apply afterwards and each find must occur exactly once.

symptoms-only.idea: Fix exactly the two reported symptoms: check before merging, pre-check the batch. Passes every visible test.

exact-rev-only.idea: Only change < to !==. Still mutates before checking, so visible tests stay red.

commit-before-write.idea: Correct staging, but swaps memory in before the write succeeds.

non-atomic-write.idea: Correct store logic, but 'simplifies' the writer to write the data file directly. Also trips the single-write and write-failure checks, which count renames.

batch-precheck-against-current.idea: Correct single update, but checks every batch op against the pre-batch revision.
